technology_name: Wax Coating Technology for Cassava Tubers
institution: ICAR-Central Tuber Crops Research Institute (CTCRI) Thiruvananthapuram
technology_type:
Post-Harvest Preservation Technology,
Food Packaging Technology,
Storage Technology
problem_solved: Short shelf life of fresh cassava roots during storage and transportation.
description: The surface coating of cassava roots is done by dipping them in hot/molten paraffin wax/other suitable wax and drying them on a bench before packaging them into boxes This technology helps the processors and traders to store, transport and sell fresh cassava roots to distant places for an extended period upto 1or 2 months and increased profitability
applications:
Cassava processing and value-addition industries
Fresh produce storage, packaging, and logistics companies
Agricultural export and trading enterprises
Farmer producer organizations (FPOs) and agricultural cooperatives
Root and tuber crop marketing and supply chain businesses
